translations.web: The demons came out of the man, and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake, and were drowned.
translations.bsb: Then the demons came out of the man and went into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and was drowned.
translations.kjv: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
translations.asv: And the demons came out from the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd rushed down the steep into the lake, and were drowned.
